user.title: Who is this for?
user.description:
Predictive Bedtime learns when someone goes to sleep from their work schedule and their bed, then predicts upcoming bedtimes so the home can get ready ahead of time.

Add one entry per person.

sources.title: Work schedule
sources.description: Pick the calendars that hold {name}'s shifts.

data_description.calendars: Timed events are treated as shifts. All-day events are ignored. Shift changes and swaps are picked up automatically.
data_description.calendar_content: Choose "other events too" for a shared or personal calendar; the next step asks how to recognise shifts.

habits.title: Starting habits
habits.description: These guide predictions until enough nights have been learned. After that, {name}'s actual bedtimes take over. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data.free_bedtime: Usual bedtime with no shift nearby

data_description.wind_down_minutes: How early the Wind-down sensor turns on, for dimming lights or cooling the bedroom.

signals.title: How to tell when {name} sleeps
signals.description: Pick at least one signal. Use as many as you have: when one is missing (a watch not worn, a flaky sensor), the others fill in.

data_description.in_bed_signals: On while {name} is in bed: a bed pressure sensor for their side, an mmWave presence sensor aimed at the bed, or similar. 20 minutes settled counts as going to sleep; 3 hours or more counts as a night.
data_description.asleep_signals: Measured sleep, such as Sleep as Android, Withings, Fitbit, or Apple Health sleep data (e.g. via Health Auto Export). Trusted straight away. Not Sleep Focus or bedtime schedules: those follow preset times, not actual sleep.
data_description.asleep_states: Only matters for trackers that report text states. Any of these states counts as asleep.

keywords.title: Recognising shifts
keywords.description: Only events whose title contains one of these words will count as {name}'s shifts.

data_description.shift_keywords: Whole words, ignoring case: "work" matches "Work (Sam)" and "Sam work" but not "Workout". Type your own and press Enter to add it.

error.no_signals: Pick at least one in-bed signal or sleep tracker.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.

data.free_bedtime: Usual bedtime with no shift nearby
data.unwind_minutes: Shortest time from shift end to bed
data.settle_minutes: Time in bed before it counts as a sleep attempt
data.wake_gap_minutes: Time out of bed before it counts as awake
data.min_sleep_hours: Shortest stretch that counts as a night

data_description.target_sleep_hours: Used until enough nights have been learned; after that, actual behaviour wins.
data_description.learning_window_days: Nights older than this are discarded. Within the window, recent nights count more.
data_description.asleep_states: Only matters for trackers that report text states.
data_description.shift_keywords: Leave empty to treat every timed event as a shift.

error.no_signals: Pick at least one in-bed signal or sleep tracker.
